name: LangChain Operations Agent
tagline: A customizable operations agent built on LangGraph — fork it, extend it, make it yours.
description:
The LangChain Operations Agent is a starter template for creators who want full control over their agent's logic. Built on LangGraph with a FastAPI adapter that implements the marketplace contract, it handles email triage, task execution, and approval routing out of the box.

Creators fork this package, customize the graph nodes, add tools, and upload the result. The adapter handles all platform integration (AgentMail, approval queue, health checks) so you can focus on the agent logic.

capabilities.name: Email triage
capabilities.description: Reads and categorizes incoming email, drafts responses

capabilities.name: Task execution
capabilities.description: Breaks down requests into steps and executes them

capabilities.name: Risk assessment
capabilities.description: Scores tasks on stakes, ambiguity, and reversibility to route approvals

capabilities.name: Approval routing
capabilities.description: Queues risky actions for human review before executing

capabilities.name: Research
capabilities.description: Researches topics and delivers structured summaries
